task_description: Archive messages older than a given number of days.
Build a cache key from a tenant name and a record id.
Mark an invoice as paid by its invoice number (a text code such as INV-2041).
Look up a session record by session token.
Mark a list of messages as read.
Count how many tickets have a given status.
Check whether a login name and password hash match a stored account.
Read a nickname saved at sign-up and list the forum posts signed with it.
Change the priority of a task, given its numeric id and the new priority.
Delete a comment by its numeric id if it belongs to the current user.
